categories.main_business_segments: The Hyakujushi Bank, Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: banking (including deposit, lending, domestic and foreign exchange operations), leasing (through Hyakujushi Lease Co., Ltd.), and other financial and non-financial services (such as credit card, credit guarantee, ICT solutions, personnel placement, and real estate management). The banking segment is the core, accounting for the majority of revenue and profit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank leverages advanced financial IT systems, including a shared regional bank system, and digital transformation initiatives such as digital banking channels, electronic contract services, and data-driven consulting. It also employs robust risk management, ALM (Asset Liability Management), and sustainability-focused lending and investment frameworks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individuals, SMEs, large corporations, and public sector entities, primarily in Kagawa Prefecture and the broader Setouchi region. The bank also serves clients in major metropolitan areas (Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Kobe, etc.) and supports local businesses with consulting, overseas expansion, and ship finance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank's main operational base is Kagawa Prefecture, with a strong presence in the Setouchi region. It maintains a network of branches in 11 prefectures across Japan, including major cities such as Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Kobe, Hiroshima, Okayama, Fukuoka, and others. International activities are limited, with recent closures of overseas offices.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hyakujushi Bank operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers (individuals, businesses, and public entities) as a retail and commercial bank, as well as providing related financial and consulting services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include evolving into a comprehensive consulting group, enhancing digital transformation (DX), promoting sustainability (SX), and maximizing human capital (HRX). The bank is focused on regional revitalization, supporting the 100-year life era, digitalization of local society, climate change response, and building a sustainable management foundation. R&D is not a major activity, but investments are made in digital and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The bank generates revenue primarily from interest income on loans, fees from financial services (including consulting, asset management, and settlement services), leasing income, and commissions from credit card and guarantee businesses. Additional income comes from securities investment and trust operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hyakujushi Bank is a leading regional bank in Kagawa Prefecture, holding approximately 50% share in deposits and 40% in loans locally. Its main competitors are other regional banks and national banks operating in the region. The bank differentiates itself through its strong local presence, consulting capabilities, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of March 2025, the bank has total assets of approximately 5.75 trillion yen, deposits of 4.7 trillion yen, and loans of 3.5 trillion yen. FY2024 consolidated ordinary income was 90 billion yen, with net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 13.7 billion yen. The bank has shown steady growth in profit and assets, with a focus on improving profitability and capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hyakujushi Bank emphasizes its deep regional roots, high market share in Kagawa, and ability to provide integrated financial and non-financial solutions tailored to local needs. Its unique value lies in comprehensive consulting, support for regional revitalization, digital and sustainability initiatives, and strong customer relationships built on trust and local engagement.
